title: game_complete postMessage payload
description: Canonical shape of the game_complete message sent from a game iframe to its parent harness. SOURCE OF TRUTH for the contract; markdown docs in the same directory mirror this schema. The companion attempt_complete message (see attempt-complete.schema.json) reuses $defs/metrics and $defs/previewResult from this file — the two payloads MUST stay field-by-field identical except for the type discriminator and the per-message-instant timestamps (data.metrics.time and data.completedAt).

completedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds at which the game ended. Use Date.now().

previewResult.description: Populated when the preview was interactive (any setPreviewData() call during preview). See PART-039.

time.description: Total game duration in SECONDS (not milliseconds). Compute as Math.round((Date.now() - gameState.startTime) / 1000). The 86400 upper bound (24 hours) is a sanity cap; values above this almost certainly indicate a missing /1000 conversion.

attempts.description: Session-scoped attempt history. Accumulates across Try Again / restartGame() within the same iframe load. Multi-round games that went through Try Again may have multiple records with the same round_number; is_retry distinguishes them. See attempt-schema.md.

duration_data.description: Per-round timing breakdown. Shape per game; consumers treat as opaque telemetry.

totalLives.description: INITIAL life budget — count of lives the player had when the question first rendered (gameState.totalLives, set at game start, never decremented). NOT the remaining count. Remaining is derivable: remaining = totalLives - (tries - 1).

tries.description: Integer counter = 1 + total_lives_lost_across_session. Initialized to 1 at startGame; incremented by 1 every time a life is lost (wrong-answer, timeout, etc.). PERSISTS across Try Again / restartGame() — does NOT reset. See postmessage-schema.md § tries — counter semantics.

correct.description: Overall game correctness. PASSTHROUGH of the `correct` argument to endGame(correct). Standalone: Submit handler's evaluation. Multi-round evaluating games: (gameState.lives > 0 && gameState.stars > 0). Feedback-only games: hardcoded true.

roundCorrectness.description: Per-round correctness, length totalRounds. Derived from gameState.attempts: walk the array and take the LAST attempt per round_number. Standalone: length-1 array equals [correct]. Multi-round: length totalRounds. Missing rounds default to false for evaluating games; feedback-only games never have missing rounds because every recordAttempt(...) uses correct: true.

time_since_start_of_game.description: MILLISECONDS from startTime. Note unit asymmetry vs metrics.time (seconds).

correct.description: Whether the answer matched the correct answer. Feedback-only games always use true.

round_number.description: 1-indexed. May repeat across the array if the player went through Try Again.

response_time_ms.description: MILLISECONDS from round mount to submission.

is_retry.description: true if a re-attempt of the same round_number (within-round retry or post-restart replay).
